R-001.description: A caller sends one job to the SQS queue and receives one result on the chosen callback.

R-002.description: Job and result contracts are versioned JSON Schemas with generated TypeScript types.

R-003.description: A deployed worker turns a valid dummy job into a stored PDF and an SQS success result.

R-004.description: Releases are cut by semantic-release and deployed through GitHub OIDC without static keys.

R-005.description: All AWS resources are provisioned by Terraform from bootstrap and the printer module.

R-006.description: Pull requests validate code, contracts, templates, and Terraform before merge.

R-007.description: Local development reproduces queue, storage, and callback behaviour with LocalStack.

R-008.description: Retries, DLQ, deterministic print identifiers, and failure results are tested.

R-009.description: Prints are encrypted, publicly inaccessible, and expire automatically after one day.

R-010.description: Conventional Commits, squash merges, and protected main are enforced locally and in CI.

R-011.description: The worker consumes only the jobs queue and may send results only to allowed targets.

R-012.description: A deployed smoke test verifies each release, and rollback deploys an earlier release.
